questions.question: What are the main features of Python?
questions.answer: Python is an interpreted, high-level programming language. It has simple syntax, supports object-oriented programming and provides many libraries.

questions.question: What is Django?
questions.answer: Django is a Python web framework used to develop web applications. It provides features such as URL routing, database integration and an admin interface.

questions.question: How would you retrieve employee records from a database?
questions.answer: I would connect the application to the database and execute a SELECT query to retrieve employee records. In Django, I could also use the ORM to access the records.
